declarations.name: BasicGauge
declarations.description:
A gauge that displays a numeric value as a meter with color-coded thresholds.
Use it for visualising a value within a known range — the needle rotates
to reflect the current value and the color indicates which threshold applies.
The `value` must be a number within the range defined by the thresholds.
Thresholds should be ordered by `min` value for correct color assignment.
The `value` attribute is observed post-connect, so setting it at runtime
(e.g. `gauge.setAttribute('value', '0.5')`) updates the gauge too, not just
the initial `value` property.

members.name: value
members.description:
Current gauge value in the range [0, meter.max]. Read from the `value`
attribute at connect time (falling back to the inner `<meter>`'s value
for markup that only sets it there), and re-parsed on later `value`
attribute mutations — e.g. from frameworks like React that set DOM
attributes rather than properties.

attributes.name: thresholds
attributes.description: Color-coded thresholds as a JSON array, e.g. `[{"min":0,"label":"Low","color":"red"}]`. Defaults to an empty array (no color/label applied) if omitted. Read once at connect time.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-label-color
cssProperties.description: Text color of the qualification label. Defaults to `--color-text-soft`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-label-font-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the qualification label. Defaults to `--font-size-s`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-metric-color
cssProperties.description: Text color of the numeric value. Defaults to `--color-text`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-metric-font-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the numeric value. Defaults to `--font-size-xl`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-ring-width
cssProperties.description: Ring thickness. Accepts any CSS length; defaults to `--space-xs`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-size
cssProperties.description: Overall gauge diameter. Accepts any CSS length; defaults to `8rem`.

cssProperties.name: --basic-gauge-track-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the unfilled ring track. Defaults to `--color-secondary`.

declarations.name: getNumberFormatter
declarations.description:
Builds an `Intl.NumberFormat` from a locale and a JSON-encoded
`Intl.NumberFormatOptions` string (typically an element's `options`
attribute). Validates `style: "currency"` and `style: "unit"` requirements,
drops options that don't apply to the resolved style, and swaps inverted
min/max digit pairs. Falls back to `new Intl.NumberFormat(locale)` for
missing/invalid input, logging via `logger`.

declarations.name: CardBlogmeta
declarations.description:
Formats and displays publication and modification dates from `<time>` element `datetime` attributes.
Use it for blog post or article metadata — the displayed dates update when the
underlying `datetime` attributes change.
The `datetime` values must be valid date strings; missing attributes are skipped.
The host element should contain `<time class="published">` and `<time class="modified">` elements.

declarations.name: CardCollapsible
declarations.description:
A collapsible card wrapping a native `<details>`/`<summary>` element.
Use it for any content that should be expandable/collapsible — content-agnostic,
the header goes in `<summary>`, the body is the rest of `<details>`'s content.
Native disclosure semantics provide keyboard toggling (Enter/Space on the summary)
and find-in-page support for free; the `open` reactive property mirrors the
descendant `<details>` element's `open` state for programmatic read/control.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the card is expanded. Reflects the descendant `<details>` element's `open` state.

declarations.name: CardColorscale
declarations.description:
A color scale card that displays a named Oklch color with a full set of lightness steps.
Use it for previewing a color palette — provides lightness tints and shades
for when you need to evaluate contrast and accessibility of a base color.
The `color` attribute must be a valid Oklch color string.

declarations.name: FormColorgraph
declarations.description:
An interactive Oklch color editor with sliders for lightness, chroma, and hue.
Use it for exploring color spaces — keyboard accessible via Arrow keys on each
slider axis, with live preview of the resulting color and out-of-gamut warnings.
Out-of-gamut colors should be handled with a fallback, as display coverage varies.
Chroma values must stay within the Oklch gamut; extreme values are clamped automatically.
Form participation submits one serialized CSS color value via ElementInternals.

declarations.name: relayValidity

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The inner native form control driving validity

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: A write-handle (e.g. a `State<string>`) for the inline error

declarations.description:
Relay an inner native form control's validity to the host and the inline
error display in one step.

- Runs `checkValidity()` on the inner control so the browser recomputes its
  `validationMessage` from native constraints (required, pattern, etc.).
- Mirrors that message into the component-internal error signal, which the
  inline `.error` element binds to.
- Forwards it to `host.setCustomValidity()` so external consumers see native
  parity (`host.validity`, `host.validationMessage`, `:user-invalid`).

declarations.name: ModuleCalctable
declarations.description:
An editable calculation table — description, amount, and price/unit columns
compute a per-row price, plus running totals in the footer. Rows are synced
via `reconcile()`; server-rendered `<tr data-key>` rows are adopted into the
initial list so they aren't stripped on first run. A trailing entry row
(marked `data-unreconciled`, exempt from reconciliation) creates a new row
once its description, amount, and price/unit are all filled; setting an
existing row's amount to 0 removes it. Currency formatting is parsed the
same way as `<basic-number>`.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: BCP 47 locale tag (e.g. `de-CH`). Falls back to the nearest ancestor's `lang` attribute, or `en` if none is set. Read once at connect time.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options as a JSON object, e.g. `{"style":"currency","currency":"EUR"}`. Read once at connect time.

declarations.name: ModuleCemList
declarations.description:
A catalog of custom-element declarations, rendered server-side from a
custom-elements-manifest by the `{% cem-list %}` Markdoc tag — the client
receives fully-formed `card-collapsible` markup and only needs to register
the tag name; `card-collapsible` and `module-tabgroup` provide all the
interactive behavior. A `<form-textbox>` descendant filters the cards by
matching its value against each card's full text content (name, tag name,
description, and members) — a client-side layer over pre-rendered markup,
no re-fetching or re-rendering involved.

Use it for exploring and selecting colors — provides form inputs for Oklch channels

The `color` attribute must be a valid Oklch color string; out-of-gamut values are clamped.

declarations.name: ModuleList
declarations.description:
A dynamic list component demonstrating the `createList()` keyed reconciliation API.
Items are added via a form submission and removed via delegated click handling,

A resizable split view with a draggable divider and keyboard support.
Use it for two-panel layouts where the user should control the split — provides
ARIA separator semantics and Arrow key support on the divider for accessibility.
Set `orientation="vertical"` for a top/bottom split.

declarations.name: ModuleTicker
declarations.description:
A high-performance stock ticker with virtualized rows, random-walk price simulation, and pause/resume control.
Use it for demonstrating the `each()` helper with large dynamic collections — rows are
virtualized for performance and the data updates should be throttled to avoid jank.

members.description: Whether the ticker is actively updating prices.

members.name: fraction

declarations.name: ModuleTodo
declarations.description:
A full-featured todo list with add, remove, complete, filter, inline editing, and
drag-and-drop reordering. Use it as a reference example of a complete Le Truc
application — keyboard accessible controls and ARIA labelling should be considered
when adapting it for production use.
Exposes the active filter as custom states (`:state(filter-active)`, `:state(filter-completed)`)
for CSS-based item visibility, so filter state cannot be spoofed by setting an attribute.
